home.title: InnovLabs. You already have AI. Nobody showed you what to do with it.
home.description: Practical AI workflows for office workers, students, founders, and companies. Twelve-week programs taught in Seoul, online courses, and a curriculum built from your own AI profile.

footer.footnote: * Everything here is an experiment. See notes.

hero.headline: You already have AI. Nobody showed you what to do with it.
hero.sub: This is what happens when someone shows you how to make it work.

worker.title: Office workers
worker.promise: Same job, half the grind. Practical AI for people who don't code.

student.title: Students
student.promise: Learn how to learn anything. Build your own way of studying, and keep it for life.

founder.title: Founders
founder.promise: Marketing, outreach, investors, contracts, design. Do the work of a team you can't afford yet.

company.title: Companies
company.promise: Train your team to use AI for real work, or build your own in-house AI tools with us.

not.headline: Korea is second in the world at paying for AI. But not even top 10 at using it.*
not.sub: The subscriptions got bought. The second half never got taught. Here's what filled the gap.

money.title: "Make money with AI"
money.body: Sells you an outcome and skips the skill. When the trend moves on, you're left with a course and no habit.

fluff.title: "What is AI?"
fluff.body: Explains the technology without touching your work. You leave informed and exactly as slow as you arrived.

bootcamp.title: "Build a product with AI"
bootcamp.body: Teaches you to ship an app. Useful, if you wanted an app. Most people wanted their afternoon back.

us.title: Not prompts. Workflows.
us.body: AI that runs inside the work you already do. We teach the setup, the habits, and the judgment, using the same tools we run our own companies on.

not.footnote: * Paid subscribers: second globally, OpenAI, June 2025. Usage: outside the top 10 countries for ChatGPT web traffic, SimilarWeb via Asia Economy, August 2025. Downloads: 21st globally, Sensor Tower, 2026.

irl.title: In person, in Seoul
irl.body: Twelve weeks standard, adjusted to the group. One-off workshops through long-form programs. Taught by people who run their own work on these tools.

online.title: Online, on your schedule
online.body: The same curriculum, self-paced. Watch, do the work, come back with questions.

custom.title: Your own curriculum
custom.body: Built from your survey, your level, and how you learn. Lives in the platform and changes as you do.

story.headline: Why we started this
story.body: In 2019 a friend at OpenAI got me into an early API program, a year before ChatGPT existed. I've built with AI every day since. Friends started asking me to set up their systems. They got 10+ hours a week back, and they all said the same thing: you should teach this. So we did.

platform.headline: AI changes daily. Keeping up is a job.
platform.body: New models, new tools, a dozen papers before lunch. It's hard to follow even for us, and following it is our work. So we built the place where you don't have to do it alone.
